title: Accelerated Failure Time Models
interviewAnswer: AFT models describe how covariates accelerate or decelerate event time directly, offering an alternative interpretation to proportional hazards models.
keyPoints: Models a distribution of log survival time.
why: Accelerated Failure Time Models is a recurring foundation across data science and machine learning because it affects both theoretical correctness and practical system behavior.
intuition: Models a distribution of log survival time.
deepDive: AFT models describe how covariates accelerate or decelerate event time directly, offering an alternative interpretation to proportional hazards models. Interpretation is time-ratio oriented. Distributional assumption matters. The interview-level skill is not merely recalling the definition: explain the assumptions, what diagnostic evidence you would inspect, and what alternative you would choose when those assumptions fail.
workedExample: A time ratio above 1 indicates a covariate is associated with longer survival under the chosen parameterization.
commonMistakes: Using the concept mechanically without checking assumptions or data semantics.
Reporting one metric/result without examining uncertainty, slices or failure modes.
followUps: What assumptions or limitations does Accelerated Failure Time Models have?
How would you validate Accelerated Failure Time Models on a real dataset?
production: In production, make assumptions explicit, validate on representative slices, compare with a simple baseline and monitor the signals that can drift.
